final_joins: Final compatibility: Parts I–II have nine direct joins. Stone-Zsela, Stevens, Souter, Ginsburg and Breyer join Parts III–IV in full. O'Connor, Scalia, Kennedy and Thomas refuse only the clear-notice application and resulting immunity-denial disposition; they expressly join the present violation, particularized standard and legal-review limits. Scalia's partial dissent is joined by O'Connor, Kennedy and Thomas. Its insufficient-notice application answers the same conduct-date sources differently, and no revision is asserted to have cured that disagreement. No Justice changes a reconciled position; no Marks synthesis applies.
